subject.title: feat(dashboard): widget capabilities — net CSP, host tools, hardened shared sandbox

question: Should dashboard HTML be granted ticket-bound access to selected Gateway reads, prompt dispatch, and cron actions through this shared sandbox contract now, with the proposed persisted grant semantics?
rationale: The code establishes a new durable authority model spanning browser isolation, Gateway authorization, persisted widget state, and public protocol methods; implementation review alone cannot choose the acceptable security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve after boundary proof
options.body: Require a security-owner review plus redacted browser diagnostics for denied and granted flows and explicit upgrade coverage before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first capability set
options.body: Ship only network or read-only capabilities first and defer prompt or cron actions until their authority model has separate approval.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary proof
recommendation.body: Require a security-owner review plus redacted browser diagnostics for denied and granted flows and explicit upgrade coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history and PR design narrative place this person closest to the proposed capability and sandbox contract.
